hotels.title: Marbella Mediterranean Opulence with Daily Breakfast & Free-Flow Wine Hour
hotels.description: Experience coastal magic at Kimpton Los Monteros Marbella, nestled along the glistening Costa del Sol. This hotel is where Andalusian soul meets Kimpton style, with Mediterranean architecture and manicured grounds setting the tone for laid-back living. Spend lazy days around the indoor or outdoor pool, then wind down in Codage Spa, where steam, stillness and skilled hands melt every last care away. Linger over local flavours at Jara before ascending to Escondido Rooftop to watch the sun dip over the horizon. Just a short drive from Marbella’s old town and its yacht-filled marina, Los Monteros gives you the best of both worlds - buzz when you want it, bliss when you don’t. As for paradise? Let’s just say it comes with sea views and seriously good sangria.

hotels.title: Costa del Sol Beachfront Glamour with Four Dining Venues & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Nestled in the heart of the sun-kissed Costa del Sol, this luxurious resort is a dazzling gem perfectly poised between the azure Mediterranean Sea and the majestic Andalusian mountains of southern Spain. Savour the sophisticated flavours of Europe at the resort’s gourmet restaurants, or unwind with a handcrafted cocktail beside the sparkling infinity pool. Discover the enchanting charm of Marbella’s historic Old Town, with its cobblestone streets and vibrant culture. For golf aficionados, the resort offers unrivalled access to some of the region’s most prestigious and scenic golf courses, ensuring every moment is touched with glamour and refinement.
